backup.production_rule: Policies and grants on public.ops_notices only: the three old policies (anon insert, anon select, authenticated ALL) are replaced by ops_notices_staff_read (read_operations) and ops_notices_manage (manage_operations); every privilege is revoked from PUBLIC/anon/authenticated, then select/insert/update granted to authenticated (deletes go through admin_soft_delete_v1) and all to service_role. No row, column or function change. restore_point and verified_at are placeholders: take a fresh backup as the LAST act before the apply and fill both (fill-restore-point.mjs).

forward_verification.name: no_policy_names_anon
forward_verification.query: select count(*) = 0 from pg_policies where schemaname = 'public' and tablename = 'ops_notices' and 'anon' = any(roles)

forward_verification.name: exactly_the_two_staff_policies
forward_verification.query: select array_agg(policyname::text order by policyname) = array['ops_notices_manage','ops_notices_staff_read'] and bool_and(qual like '%current_staff_authorized%') and bool_and(case policyname when 'ops_notices_staff_read' then cmd = 'SELECT' else cmd = 'ALL' and with_check like '%manage_operations%' end) from pg_policies where schemaname = 'public' and tablename = 'ops_notices'

forward_verification.name: anon_holds_no_privilege
forward_verification.query: select not has_table_privilege('anon', 'public.ops_notices', 'select, insert, update, delete, truncate, references, trigger')

forward_verification.name: authenticated_select_insert_update_only
forward_verification.query: select has_table_privilege('authenticated', 'public.ops_notices', 'select') and has_table_privilege('authenticated', 'public.ops_notices', 'insert') and has_table_privilege('authenticated', 'public.ops_notices', 'update') and not has_table_privilege('authenticated', 'public.ops_notices', 'delete, truncate, references, trigger')

forward_verification.name: service_role_keeps_access
forward_verification.query: select has_table_privilege('service_role', 'public.ops_notices', 'select') and has_table_privilege('service_role', 'public.ops_notices', 'insert') and has_table_privilege('service_role', 'public.ops_notices', 'update') and has_table_privilege('service_role', 'public.ops_notices', 'delete')

forward_verification.name: rls_on_and_policy_helper_callable
forward_verification.query: select (select relrowsecurity from pg_class where oid = 'public.ops_notices'::regclass) and has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'public.current_staff_authorized(text, uuid)', 'execute')

steps.name: run_compensating_script
steps.action: apply supabase/rollbacks/20261007_ops_notices_rls.sql with run-sql-on-host.sh: restores the three old policies and ALL to anon and authenticated, as read on 2026-10-07. It reopens the public write path; prefer a forward fix.

feature_flags.name: no_function_redeploy_needed
feature_flags.required_state: Policies and grants only. power-watch, telegram-expense (/brownout, poster save, notice edit), calendar-sync, daily-digest and _shared/brownout.ts use SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY and keep their access; staff_home_v1, get_admin_overview_v1 and admin_soft_delete_v1 are SECURITY DEFINER. The admin dashboard Notices page (owner/admin) holds manage_operations. No Edge Function, page or Apps Script change.
